title: What's inside uridecodebin3?
description: Bins inside bins, pads that appear while it plays, a queue per stream.

title: Which element is slowing the pipeline? (answer: x264enc, its input queue stays full)
description: video-queue is full in front of x264enc, the slowest element; audio-queue is full only because mp4mux waits for the video.

title: Why does my live encode take seconds to start? (answer: x264enc holds frames back before its first output)
description: Frames go in, none come out for over 3 s; the pipeline waits in PAUSED.

title: "not-negotiated": which link failed?
description: No videoconvert after the decoder: the video stops, the audio waits, and nothing says why.

title: Pipeline hangs: the tee without queues
description: The first branch holds the tee's thread; the second never gets a buffer.

title: A snapshot of playbin3: every element, every property
description: One moment of a whole player: bins inside bins, and each element's settings to look up.
